description: OpenHPL is the OpenSimHub Modelica library for hydropower systems, from single hydraulic components to complete plants with electrical controls. It includes waterway, turbine, generator and controller models, with interfaces to other Modelica libraries such as OpenIPSL. Inputs describe water conduits, machine parameters, control settings and flow conditions; outputs are dynamic hydraulic and electrical states. A user defines the plant, simulation period and numerical resolution. The repository announces version 4.0.0 in August 2026 and releases source under MPL-2.0. A limitation is that a real plant needs calibrated component parameters and a compatible Modelica environment; example configurations are not operational forecasts. OpenHPL supports hydropower control and water-energy interaction studies. It complements broader electricity-system models such as PyPSA (model-pypsa), but no coupling was tested. The model code and release notes were inspected without installing Modelica.
